scope: Provenance audit for the original B checkpoint used to continue Gen6; not a scientific qualification result.

checkpoint.interpretation: Generation 5 checkpoint was durably written; the B trajectory did not complete all 12 generations in the original run.

source_identity.source_interpretation: The original checkpoint was produced by the proving-ground B laboratory snapshot (behavioral_search Git blob SHA-1 90616f...), not directly by importing the upstream runtime behavioral_search blob fdd752.... Both identities must remain distinct.

evidence: The producer workflow job-level environment pins SEED, GENERATIONS, PROVING_SHA, A_SHA, and B_SHA, but does not set PYTHONHASHSEED.
The producer invokes Python without an inline PYTHONHASHSEED override.
The producer log does not record os.environ[PYTHONHASHSEED] or sys.flags.hash_randomization.
hash_seed_provenance.replay_policy: Any continuation must explicitly set and record PYTHONHASHSEED. Such a continuation is an exact state continuation, not a byte-identical replay of the original process.

hash_type_policy.checkpoint_raw_sha256: SHA-256 of the complete checkpoint file bytes; 64 hexadecimal digits.
hash_type_policy.git_blob_sha1_fields: Git object IDs returned by git hash-object for repository file contents; 40 hexadecimal digits. They must not be labeled SHA-256.
hash_type_policy.state_digest: Application checkpoint state digest, distinct from both the raw-file SHA-256 and Git blob SHA-1.
